What it does

Expensify scans receipts and matches them to card transactions, which suits businesses where staff buy materials on the move. The free tier covers light use. It is worth noting that the pricing model has changed more than once, which has frustrated long-standing users.

Where the AI actually is

Scans receipts and matches them to transactions automatically.

Pros

  • Very good receipt scanning
  • Works well for reimbursable expenses
  • Free tier for light use

Cons

  • Pricing model changed repeatedly, which frustrates users

Who it suits

Built with General contractors, Remodelers & carpenters in mind. Businesses with staff buying materials on the go.

Alternatives

  • QuickBooks

    Accounting software most trade businesses end up on.

  • FreshBooks

    Simple invoicing and accounting for very small businesses.

  • Xero

    Cloud accounting with a large add-on marketplace.

  • Dext

    Receipt and invoice capture that feeds your accounts.

Prices shown are indicative as of September 2026 and change often. Always confirm on the vendor's own site.
